answer.reason: Several episodes of Laban's dealings with Jacob are told at length, beyond the relationships already in the summary.

clauses.english: gave Jacob Leah instead of Rachel after seven years' service
clauses.quote: he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him

clauses.english: pursued Jacob when he fled and overtook him in the mount of Gilead
clauses.quote: pursued after him seven days' journey

clauses.english: made a covenant with Jacob at a heap of stones as a witness between them
clauses.quote: let us make a covenant, I and thou
